# Arun Arumugam

> Arun Arumugam. Agent engineering: projects and notes. Role: Agent Engineering.

Every post below is also available as clean Markdown: append `index.md` to its URL. Full sitemap: https://arun477.github.io/sitemap.xml. Feed: https://arun477.github.io/index.xml. What changed (agents: read before publishing): https://arun477.github.io/changelog/index.md. The home page is managed by an agent; rules: https://github.com/arun477/arun477.github.io/blob/main/docs/home-agent.md.

## Posts

- [FireScroll: Short Videos That Teach](https://arun477.github.io/posts/firescroll/index.md): Say a topic. An agent researches the web, writes a cited script, narrates it and renders a scrollable feed of short vertical videos.
- [Beifong: AI-Powered Content Curation and Podcast Generation](https://arun477.github.io/posts/beifong_podcast_generator/index.md): Point it at your feeds. It collects RSS and social posts, curates what matters to you and turns it into podcasts you can listen to.
- [Jupyter to LLM Extractor](https://arun477.github.io/posts/jupyter_extractor/index.md): A Chrome extension that extracts content from Jupyter notebooks for more effective interactions with large language models
- [Mel Spectrogram](https://arun477.github.io/posts/mel_spectrogram/index.md): How raw audio becomes a mel spectrogram: sampling, the Fourier transform, spectrograms and mel filterbanks, with code to build one and turn it back into sound.
- [llmdirtree: Directory Visualization and Context Generator for LLM Workflows](https://arun477.github.io/posts/directory-tree-generator/index.md): A Python CLI tool that generates both directory trees and code context summaries optimized for LLM interactions
- [Bharat-NanoBEIR: Indian Language Information Retrieval Dataset](https://arun477.github.io/posts/embedding_eval_for_indic/index.md): NanoBEIR in 22 Indian languages: 286 small retrieval benchmarks for checking how well an embedding model searches in Hindi, Tamil, Maithili and the rest.

## Themes

The running Feed synthesized into ranked storylines, each with its evidence. Everything as JSON: https://arun477.github.io/themes/index.json. Current themes:

- [Safety, security and provenance go operational](https://arun477.github.io/themes/safety-security-and-provenance-go-operational/index.md): Safety and security work is turning into standing practice: OpenAI rewrote its Model Spec around five core values covering agent side effects, and an upcoming OpenAI cyber model found, validated and patched 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation bugs in one autonomous run. Anthropic open-sourced FlashProve so providers can prove a reply came from committed weights, while Cloudflare tracked rapid exploitation of weak CA keys and used AI-assisted analysis to map affected systems. Provenance, verification and agent-driven defense are joining red-teaming and oversight as day-to-day lab practice.
- [Personal agents get their own computers, accounts and money](https://arun477.github.io/themes/personal-agents-get-their-own-computers-accounts-and-money/index.md): Always-on personal agents keep picking up real-world reach: Claude can now read bank and card data through Plaid, Grok Bot places phone calls on the user's behalf, and Perplexity Teammates run persistent jobs inside Computer with memory, skills and Slack. OpenAI's LifeVal scores everyday assistant tasks done via browser and connectors, while Cloudflare treats verified personal agents as a first-class traffic class with analytics and allow/block policies. The agent is becoming a standing intermediary with identity and access, so permissions and site-side controls matter as much as the model.
- [Agents become long-running, parallel and stateful](https://arun477.github.io/themes/agents-become-long-running-parallel-and-stateful/index.md): Agents are moving from single chats to long jobs: parallel agents in ChatGPT Pro, Gemini agents playing Minecraft for 27 hours, durable pi agents and dedicated memory models, and GitHub rebuilding Copilot around parallel agent sessions. The harness keeps expanding: Cursor Cloud Agents now scaffold, host and share live web apps from a prompt, Mistral Studio runs long-lived managed agents with approvals, sandboxes and tracing, and Figma post-trained its own design-editing model so its agent can edit the canvas reliably. Anthropic's write-up of agent memory treats offline "dreaming" as the pass that corrects bad notes, builds lasting memory and preloads the next session. The hard problems remain state, memory, orchestration and specialized tools around the model.
- [Closed labs ship new flagships and faster tiers](https://arun477.github.io/themes/closed-labs-ship-new-flagships-and-faster-tiers/index.md): Closed labs keep shipping capability and speed tiers: Tencent's Hy4 adds vision and computer use to its flagship line, OpenAI shipped ChatGPT Images 2.6 with faster GPT-Image-2.6 API models, and Google DeepMind's Genie 4 is a real-time interactive world model. Earlier GPT-6.1 Terra and Gemini 4 Carbon pushed the same pattern of agent-ready speed and private leaderboard tests. Competition stays on multimodal reach, price tiers and workloads agents can actually run.
- [AI turns to maths and science research](https://arun477.github.io/themes/ai-turns-to-maths-and-science-research/index.md): Labs keep pointing frontier models at research work: OpenAI published maths results and opened GPT-Rosalind to academic labs, Anthropic used Claude to help map the first 3D structure of a bacterial vault particle, and Deep Principle released Hydrogen-1.0, an open-weight science model post-trained for chemistry, materials and life sciences. OpenAI's BioBasicsBench now scores agents on raw wet-lab gels, plates and instrument data from real experiments, so science evaluation is catching up with the research demos. Formal review still matters for the biggest claims, from Yang-Mills working groups to Lean-checked complexity results. Research results are becoming both a capability signal and a product line.
- [Infrastructure strains under agent-scale code](https://arun477.github.io/themes/infrastructure-strains-under-agent-scale-code/index.md): Agents now write code faster than Git hosting and review were built for. GitHub moved repositories to Azure under agent-driven load and has published the redesign of its Git object storage; OpenAI built Pando, a Rust Git backend for thousands of concurrent pushes from engineers and Codex agents, cutting median push latency by about 80% on a petabyte-scale monorepo. Anthropic built its own source control after merges grew more than tenfold, and teams are answering review load with automation such as Meta's just-in-time tests. Tooling built for human pace is giving way first.
- [Assistants move into the tools people already use](https://arun477.github.io/themes/assistants-move-into-the-tools-people-already-use/index.md): Assistants keep spreading into surfaces people already live in: Stripe now lets any business query payments data through an agent via MCP, and Meta rolled out Muse Voice and Realtime Avatar across mobile, web and Mac. Muse Spaces goes further, letting people describe a planner, tracker or hub and get a persistent mini-app Muse builds and keeps updated in the background. That sits alongside Claude in Google Docs and Sheets, live dashboards in Claude, and Cursor bundled into familiar subscriptions. Distribution through existing tools remains as important as raw model quality.
- [Sandboxes and limits for agents that act](https://arun477.github.io/themes/sandboxes-and-limits-for-agents-that-act/index.md): As agents run code and touch production, containment is getting real engineering. Vercel's sandbox challenge surfaced a kernel zero-day and Vercel details narrowly scoped production access; Codex on Windows moved to a container sandbox and Google offers a microVM per agent. Figma built Nimbus to run tens of thousands of isolated AI sandboxes for untrusted code across its AI products. Isolation at scale, not click-through prompts, is becoming the default control.
- [Open-weight models reach the frontier](https://arun477.github.io/themes/open-weight-models-reach-the-frontier/index.md): Mistral Large 4, now shipped as roughly 1T-parameter open weights tuned for coding agents, Meta's Muse Spark Open, Reflection's Beam and Moonshot's 2.8T-parameter Kimi K3.1 Pro have put frontier-scale models under open licences within a few weeks, and MiniMax's open-weight M3.1 Flash topped OpenCode before it was even named. Vercel's gateway data shows open weights already carry most production tokens, and Meta and DeepSeek have published recipes and engines for running them cheaply. Self-hosting is now a real alternative to paid APIs for coding and agent work.
- [Anthropic reshapes its governance on the way to an IPO](https://arun477.github.io/themes/anthropic-reshapes-its-governance-on-the-way-to-an-ipo/index.md): Anthropic filed an S-1 to list on Nasdaq as ANT, a week after committing 5% of its shares to a Public Benefit Fund that, with staff pledges, puts about 20% of its equity toward public benefit. It also handed its Agent Skills standard to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, as it did with MCP. A frontier lab going public puts its finances and governance in the open and sets a template for how safety-focused labs raise capital.

## Feed

Tech news and engineering blog posts, picked daily by an agent. Everything as JSON: https://arun477.github.io/feed/index.json. RSS: https://arun477.github.io/feed/index.xml. Latest days:

- [Muse Spaces; BioBasicsBench; Claude agent memory](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-11-06/index.md): Meta lets Muse build persistent mini-apps from a prompt; OpenAI scores agents on raw wet-lab data; Anthropic explains dreaming as the offline pass that keeps agent memory honest.
- [Claude Personal Finance; Perplexity Teammates; Muse Voice](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-11-05/index.md): Consumer agents get bank access, persistent coworkers and voice; Cursor and Mistral ship deploy paths; Cloudflare and Stripe meet agents on the web.
- [Tencent releases Hy4, its new flagship model with vision and computer](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-11-04/index.md)
- [OpenAI's Pando Git backend](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-11-03/index.md): How OpenAI rebuilt Git serving for agent-scale concurrent pushes.
- [OpenAI's LifeVal benchmark; Hydrogen-1.0 open science model](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-11-02/index.md): OpenAI measures everyday personal-agent tasks; Deep Principle opens a GLM-5.3-based science model.
- [Claude agents beat a training-data monitor; agents get the desktop](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-31/index.md): Anthropic shows automated red-teaming can find harmless-looking data that teaches misalignment, and Vercel Labs opens up desktop computer use for any coding agent.
- [Malicious Claude Code extension hits Cursor's marketplace](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-30/index.md): A tampered Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace tried to install an SSH backdoor on up to 5,000 machines; affected users should update and check for compromise.
- [GitHub rebuilds Copilot around agents; OpenAI API credits for Pro](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-29/index.md): GitHub's Universe launches put agents and multi-model routing at the center of Copilot, and OpenAI now bundles monthly API credit with paid ChatGPT plans.
- [Gemini 4 Carbon leads a new private benchmark; AI vets Yang-Mills](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-28/index.md): Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Carbon tops the new Artificial Analysis Index v5, which now scores mostly on private tests. Mistral ships a Responses API for agents, KITP convenes a review of an AI Yang-Mills result, and Anthropic finds analysts follow their agent's hidden lean.
- [DeepMind's Genie 4 world model; Anthropic moves into drug discovery](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-27/index.md): Google DeepMind shows Genie 4, a real-time interactive world model. Anthropic shares lessons from six drug-discovery partnerships, Google Research proposes a sleep phase for continual learning, and LangChain details how it built its design agent.
- [Anthropic files for an IPO; OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Terra](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-26/index.md): Anthropic files its S-1 to list on Nasdaq. OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra brings near-Astra computer use at a fraction of the cost, Cursor opens its Agent SDK, and Cloudflare details a cross-tenant KV cache leak in SGLang.
- [Block's Dessa: a voice model that never saw text](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-25/index.md): A quiet weekend. The one release worth knowing is Block's Dessa, a full-duplex speech model trained purely on conversation audio that runs on a laptop.
- [AI agents find a Brotli RCE; patch Node.js, Bun and Python](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-24/index.md): OpenAI's containment red-team surfaced CVE-2026-111497 in Google's Brotli decoder, now patched across major runtimes.
- [Kimi K3.1 Pro opens up; labs tighten model containment](https://arun477.github.io/feed/2026-10-23/index.md): Moonshot shipped a 2.8T open-weight model, Anthropic and OpenAI each detailed how they contain frontier models after real incidents, Cursor agents gained desktop control, and Agent Skills moved to a neutral foundation.
